pairs: Et nunc hæc dicit Dominus creans te,
And now thus says the Lord who created you,
and I have called you by your name.
When you pass through the waters,
and the rivers will not cover you.
et flamma non ardebit in te.
and the flames will not scorch you.
For I am the Lord your God,
the Holy One of Israel, your Savior.
I have presented Egypt as your atonement,
Ethiopia and Seba on your behalf.
Ex quo honorabilis factus es in oculis meis,
Since then, you have become honorable in my eyes, and glorious.
ego dilexi te, et dabo homines pro te,
and I will present men on behalf of you,
and people on behalf of your life.
I will lead your offspring from the East,
and I will gather you from the West.
I will say to the North,
Bring my sons from far away,
et filias meas ab extremis terræ.
and my daughters from the ends of the earth.
Et omnem qui invocat nomen meum,
And each one who calls upon my name,
I have created for my glory.
Lead forth the people who are blind
All the nations have been assembled together,
and the tribes have been collected.
Who among you will announce this,
et quæ prima sunt audire nos faciet?
and who will cause us to listen to the things that are first?
and you are my servant, whom I have chosen,
et intelligatis quia ego ipse sum;
and so that you may understand that I am the same.
ante me non est formatus Deus,
Before me, there was no god formed,
and after me there will be none.
et non est absque me salvator.
And there is no savior apart from me.
I have caused it to be heard.
et non fuit in vobis alienus:
And there was no stranger among you.
And from the beginning, I am the same.
et non est qui de manu mea eruat. Operabor,
And there is no one who can rescue from my hand. I act,
and who can turn it aside?
your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel:
For your sake, I sent to Babylon,
and tore down all their bars,
et Chaldæos in navibus suis gloriantes.
with the Chaldeans who glory in their ships.
who gave you a way through the sea
and a path through the torrent of waters,
who led out the chariot and the horse,
They have been crushed like flax,
You need not call to mind the past,
nor consider the things of antiquity.
Behold, I am accomplishing new things.
And presently, they will spring forth.
With certainty, you will know them.
I will make a way in the desert,
and rivers in an impassible place.
The wild beasts of the field will glorify me,
For I have brought waters to the desert,
in order to give drink to my people,
This is the people whom I have formed for myself.
But you have not called upon me,
nor have you struggled for me,
Non obtulisti mihi arietem holocausti tui,
You have not offered me the ram of your holocaust,
et victimis tuis non glorificasti me;
and you have not glorified me with your victims.
non te servire feci in oblatione,
I have not burdened you with oblations,
nec laborem tibi præbui in thure.
nor have I wearied you with incense.
You have bought me no sweet cane with money,
et adipe victimarum tuarum non inebriasti me:
and you have not inebriated me with the fat of your victims.
verumtamen servire me fecisti in peccatis tuis;
Yet truly, you have burdened me with your sins;
præbuisti mihi laborem in iniquitatibus tuis.
you have wearied me with your iniquities.
ego sum ipse qui deleo iniquitates tuas propter me,
I am the very One who wipes away your iniquities for my own sake.
And I will not remember your sins.
Reduc me in memoriam, et judicemur simul:
Call me to mind, and let us go to judgment together.
narra si quid habes ut justificeris.
If you have anything to justify yourself, explain it.
et interpretes tui prævaricati sunt in me:
and your interpreters have betrayed me.
And so, I have defiled the holy leaders.
dedi ad internecionem Jacob, et Israël in blasphemiam.
I have handed over Jacob to slaughter, and Israel to calumny.
